size_basis: estimated: raster scale taken from the 1 3/8 in full-size ribbon = 100 px (72.73 px/in; miniature rasters at the same scale = half-size medal); DoDM 1348.33 dimension text was not available to cite

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon is bound by name to the military ribbon assets (assets/ribbons/military)

fit_score.note: mask IoU of the traced outline vs the ribbon-stripped body of the product raster (100x220 / 50x176 px source: low resolution, relief shading is not reproduced)

notes: Outline is the real silhouette of the product raster (smoothed); fill is the sampled median metal colour with one top-to-bottom gradient and an inset rim ring; only large (>=3% of the body) colour features are kept. Relief, lettering and fine engraving are NOT reproduced (source rasters are 50-100 px). Ribbon not included.
